name: awesome-safegraph-datascience
what_it_holds: Curated list of SafeGraph-ecosystem notebooks, dashboards, and academic papers using foot-traffic data (retail, tourism, urban-park visitation, pharmacy demand). Points to SafeGraph's paid Data Bar marketplace and an academic/community free-access program (application-gated, not a public download) rather than any directly downloadable dataset.
why_useful: Useful map of who has built travel/leisure foot-traffic analyses on SafeGraph (e.g. urban park visitation, brand-level POI visit counts) that could be replicated if academic access to SafeGraph/Dewey Data is secured; not itself a data source.

Index into secondary SafeGraph-derived datasets that might include hospitality/tourism-adjacent foot traffic studies worth a deeper look.

name: SafeGraph-PublicCompanies
what_it_holds: Dewey Data's official notebook (SafeGraph-CompustatLinking.ipynb) matching SafeGraph Brand-level POI foot-traffic data to publicly traded tickers via SEC EDGAR + Compustat linking (ticker/fuzzy-name match). Requires a Dewey Data SafeGraph Brand subscription and WRDS Compustat access; no data or sample files committed.
why_useful: Direct evidence that SafeGraph/Dewey sell brand-level foot-traffic time series mappable to public tickers (which would in principle cover hotel/travel-adjacent public comps, though not Airbnb itself since it has no storefronts) — a method for a future workstream if paid Dewey access is obtained, not a free dataset today.
geography: US public companies with physical POIs
